newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Riksbank to leave repo flat on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Riksbank to leave repo flat on Tuesday.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, will leave its key repurchase rate at an unchanged 4.10 percent at its weekly tender on Tuesday, a poll showed.

Of 10 economists surveyed by Reuters, all said the Riksbank would leave the rate unchanged. They said a weak and volatile crown stopped the bank from trimming the rate, which was last cut on December 17.
"In its inflation report the Riksbank said that the crown must strengthen before the repo rate could be cut. We think the TCW index must strengthen to 117," one economist said.

On Thursday the crown was at 122.18 on the TCW index. The Riksbank has said the crown's equilibrium value against the TCW trade-weighted index should be in the interval of 109 to 118 with the focus on the lower half of the range.
Sources in the survey were Carnegie, Consensus, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, IDEA, Nomura, Nordbanken, S-E-Banken, Sparbanken and Transferator.
